summary: Pre-trial difficulty design is genuine coupled failover reasoning: fence/epoch ownership, write routing, sticky pins, watermark lag, standby sync sanitation, capture idempotency, and /readyz versus dump accepting_checkout interact so local fixes stay globally wrong. Hardness is not Django LOC volume or obscure trivia. Official Harbor GPT×5+Claude×5 trials are deferred, so the empirical tier is UNMEASURED / NOT_MEASURABLE.

evidence.observation: Incident requires one fenced writer, sticky non-lagged reads, pins outside django_session, single capture per attempt_id, LSN-gated pay/capture, and multi-condition /readyz plus failover-status.json—several interacting correctness dimensions, not a single missing if.
Runbook separates live /readyz gates from stricter dump accepting_checkout (pins shared, incident orders on standby, fence not writable on standby), creating partial-heal traps.
On-call evidence names dual symptoms (AZ-B POSTs to replica, confirmation OPEN, duplicate captures, half-copied writable lease) that must be reconciled together.
Starter write path can divert AZ-B mutations to replica under leftover affinity/split dispositions; fixing DATABASES alone does not heal placement.
replica_eligible uses order row counts and can return True when az-b Node exists, conflicting with watermark max_lag_lsn gating required elsewhere.
Sticky pins are mirrored into default cache and ShopSession/django_session, so pins vanish across box remap even if a pins alias exists.
sync_standby still copies ha_fence_lease as writable and truncates apply LSN via cutoff, so standby can remain a second writer after copy.
claim_side_effect always creates a new SideEffect row, so retry/cross-box capture duplicates are structural rather than a one-line guard.
/readyz always returns 200 with accepting_checkout true while /healthz is process-up, encoding the classic false-ready partial fix.
Oracle must replace ten interacting modules (router, fencing, lag, sessions, idempotency, replica, reports, views, settings, fulfill services) then sync/cutover/heal state—not a fixture dump.

Twenty-eight F2P cases span writer placement, seq-gated reads, shared pins, cutover epoch, capture uniqueness/LSN block, /readyz blockers, failover-status accept/refuse combinations, and reconnect survival—coupled families rather than clerical one-assert-per-file volume.

findings.why_it_matters: Packet defers official Harbor model trials; any declared metadata difficulty remains an author estimate until combined GPT×5+Claude×5 mean pass@1 is measured.
findings.minimal_remediation: After Pre-LLMaJ/Harbor maturity, run the official 10 trials and set DIFFICULTY_VERDICT / task.toml difficulty from the combined complete-run mean.
findings.regression_risk: None for design PASS; empirical tier may differ from design intuition.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction and runbook enumerate many gates and the dump schema, so a strong agent may checklist-patch modules without deep diagnosis; that raises shortcut risk but does not convert the task into clerical volume—partial patches still fail interacting F2P families.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep coupled counterexamples; do not further flatten requirements into a repair recipe. Recalibrate after official trials if pass rate is unexpectedly high.
findings.regression_risk: Low if verifier families stay independent and counterexample-backed.

missing_evidence: Combined 10-trial per-test solvability matrix and trajectories
do_not_change: Do not collapse fence, routing, pins, lag, capture, and readiness into a single-module bug to chase early pass rate.
Do not treat surrounding catalog/inventory/identity LOC as the difficulty signal.
Do not assign a final Edition 3 tier before combined official 10 trials.
next_gate: Continue Pre-LLMaJ / Harbor path; defer official model trials for empirical tier
